work.text: Eve droops fainting over the dead Abel, who lies beside an open grave. Cain turns to fly with a gesture of despair. Flames kindle around him, and the sun sets in blood behind dim blue hills

source.author: W. Graham Robertson

moment.text: Blake lived for twenty-three years after the date on the title-page of Jerusalem, but, with the exception of the two plates called The Ghost of Abel, engraved in 1822, this vast and obscure encyclopaedia of unknown regions remains his last gospel.
To Lord Byron in the Wilderness.--What dost thou here, Elijah? Can a Poet doubt the Visions of Jehovah? Nature has no Outline: But Imagination has.

matters.text: EVE fainted over the dead body of ABEL which lays near a grave. ADAM kneels by her. JEHOVAH stands above. … VOICE. O Earth, cover not thou my blood! cover not thou my blood!
